title: EHD Droplet Deformation & Taylor-Melcher Circulation
description: Axisymmetric boundary element simulation of an uncharged leaky dielectric droplet suspended in an immiscible fluid under a uniform DC electric field. Demonstrates transient dynamics starting from initial prolate perturbation ($D > 0$) settling into steady oblate equilibrium ($D \approx -0.0864$) accompanied by quadrupolar internal circulation vortices driven by interfacial free charge accumulation.
